Legal Terms

Terms & Conditions

Terms governing our academic counseling and advisory services.

1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing our website or utilizing the admission counseling services offered by JB Siksha Institute, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions. If you disagree with any part of these terms, please refrain from using our services.

2. Scope of Advisory Services

JB Siksha Institute functions strictly as an independent educational consultancy and academic advisory platform. We guide candidates on course selection, preference order filing (ACPC/JoSAA/NEET), and eligibility criteria compliance for partner institutes and statutory admission committees.

3. Limitation of Liability

Final admission decisions, merit list ranks, fee structures, and seat allocations are determined solely by the respective university authorities, state regulatory committees, or government bodies (e.g., UGC, AICTE, NMC, ACPC). JB Siksha Institute bears no liability for university decision changes, regulatory updates, or rejection due to false documentation provided by candidates.

4. Accuracy of Information & User Obligations

Candidates and parents are responsible for providing accurate, authentic academic records, identity proofs, and category certificates during consultations. Any discrepancies in submitted documents are the sole responsibility of the applicant.

5. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India. Any legal disputes arising out of our advisory services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in Gandhidham, Kachchh, Gujarat.

6. Modifications to Service Terms

We reserve the right to revise or update these terms at any time without prior notice. Continued use of our website or counseling services following changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
